001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
009import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
010import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
011
012/**
013 *
014 * @author jimmy
015 */
016public class PropIntMemberNonemptySet extends Propagator<Variable> {
017
018    private final IntVar element;
019    private final SetVar set;
020    private final IntVar setCard;
021
022    public PropIntMemberNonemptySet(IntVar element, SetVar set, IntVar setCard) {
023        super(new Variable[]{set, element, setCard}, PropagatorPriority.BINARY, false);
024        this.element = element;
025        this.set = set;
026        this.setCard = setCard;
027    }
028
029    @Override
030    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
031        if (!PropUtil.isDomIntersectKer(element, set)) {
032            if (setCard.getLB() > 0) {
033                setCard.updateLowerBound(set.getLB().size() + 1, this);
034            }
035            if (setCard.getUB() == set.getLB().size() + 1) {
036                // set can take only one more value, and currently does not intersect element.
037                ISetIterator iter = set.getUB().iterator();
038                while (iter.hasNext()) {
039                    int i = iter.nextInt();
040                    if (!set.getLB().contains(i) && !element.contains(i)) {
041                        set.remove(i, this);
042                    }
043                }
044            }
045        }
046        if (setCard.getLB() > 0) {
047            PropUtil.domSubsetEnv(element, set, this);
048            if (element.isInstantiated()) {
049                set.force(element.getValue(), this);
050                setPassive();
051            }
052        } else if (!PropUtil.isDomIntersectEnv(element, set)) {
053            setCard.instantiateTo(0, this);
054        } else {
055//            PropUtil.domSubsetEnv(element, set, this);
056        }
057    }
058
059    @Override
060    public ESat isEntailed() {
061        if (setCard.getLB() > 0) {
062            if (!PropUtil.isDomIntersectEnv(element, set)) {
063                return ESat.FALSE;
064            }
065            if (PropUtil.isDomSubsetKer(element, set)) {
066                return ESat.TRUE;
067            }
068            return ESat.UNDEFINED;
069        } else if (setCard.getUB() == 0) {
070            return ESat.TRUE;
071        } else if (setCard.getDomainSize() == 2
072                && set.getUB().size() == setCard.getUB()
073                && PropUtil.isDomSubsetEnv(element, set)) {
074            return ESat.TRUE;
075        }
076        return ESat.UNDEFINED;
077    }
078
079    @Override
080    public String toString() {
081        return element + " in " + set + " with " + setCard + " if not empty";
082    }
083}
